analysiskitlocal: the Analysis Kit workflow as a package

Source: R/analysiskitlocal-package.R
analysiskitlocal-package.Rd

Turns a research dataset and a List of Analysis (LoA) workbook into a validated, MMC-branded results workbook, without an interface.

The one function most runs need

run_analysis_locally() does the whole workflow: read both files, check them against each other, run every requested analysis across every disaggregation, and write the results workbook to a folder.

run <- run_analysis_locally(
  dataset       = "data/mmr_analysis_data_25_26.xlsx",
  loa           = "resources/loa_template.xlsx",
  output_folder = "output"
)

Doing it a step at a time

Every stage is its own function, so a run can be inspected, altered or repeated at any point:

read_analysis_dataset()

read and profile a .csv / .xlsx dataset.

read_loa_workbook()

read every recognised sheet of the LoA workbook, interpreting nothing.

check_analysis_inputs()

validate the workbook against the dataset. Reports errors, warnings and variable coverage, and never stops.

build_analysis_spec()

turn the workbook into the single internal description of a run.

run_analysis_spec()

run a specification.

run_group_analysis_pipeline()

the analysis engine itself, callable directly with plain R arguments and no workbook at all.

ak_export_results()

write a completed run to a folder.

Which functions run an analysis

Anything that executes an analysis is named run_*: run_analysis_locally(), run_analysis_spec() and run_group_analysis_pipeline(). Everything else reads, validates, reshapes or writes.

The LoA workbook

The schema is documented in full in the copy that ships with the package:

file.edit(system.file("extdata", "loa-schema.md",
                      package = "analysiskitlocal"))
copy_loa_template("resources")   # a workbook to start from
